notes: B14-B17 were absent from the MG corpus (0 crosswalk units), so every OR/LOG "missing" in MG must be re-read against them; done here.
MG host IDs for these domains are not meaningful military modules (e.g. M:LOG.1.1 -> M13.13 attitude control; M:OR.4.1 -> M2.10 threshold detection); all hosts were reassigned.
Rule 33 (core/app/src/prompt.ts; docs/CORE_TEACHING_RULES.md): learner has already read B14 and B15 -> those items are test-out candidates (diagnostic quiz), never removal.
Rule 37: ref sources are not lesson material and are excluded from coverage checks -> B16/B17 content is effectively untaught; LOG/ACQ/CRAFT/ADV.3-4 have no host module at all.

B15 page offset PDF=book+21; B14 offset drifts 7->1 (blank pages dropped); B16 offset drifts 24->39; B17 is an unpaginated ebook. All pages here are PDF pages. B12 SMAD and B13 Fleeman are image-only scans (not text-verifiable).
